QUOTE: enable `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus either `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (on POSIX) or `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C as the gating macro and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the implementation macro, and it says the threading code is compiled only under `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`.
